prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: native pixel-art horizontal gaze atlas for a Daggerfall Unity NPC portrait animation
Input image: the single provided local thinking-reference-grid.png is the exact selected NPC073 afraid open/half eye source, face, palette, framing, and pixel-art reference.
Primary request: Create one 2×2 horizontal gaze atlas with the same aspect ratio, crop size, registration, and panel arrangement as the reference. Top row LEFT OPEN, RIGHT OPEN. Bottom row LEFT HALF, RIGHT HALF. Each cell is a complete aligned 64:35 upper portrait crop. No labels, borders, gutters, extra panels, or text.
Expression: Keep the selected afraid expression in every cell. Preserve the visibly raised, inward-pinched fearful brows and the same brow geometry across all four cells. Keep the upper-lid aperture and eye size from the corresponding open or half reference phase; HALF remains clearly half-closed with the selected upper lids covering part of each iris.
Gaze: Change only horizontal gaze. For LEFT, both compact amber/olive-brown irises and pupils glance together toward the viewer's left, remaining naturally centered within each eye opening. For RIGHT, both glance together toward the viewer's right. Make the lateral change readable at native pixel scale, around one native pixel if suitable, without changing pupil size or eye anatomy. Do not move gaze vertically.
Constraints: Preserve the tiny muted glints, source eye spacing, warm skin, hair, blue wand, identity, crop, framing, soft native pixel clusters, and original palette. Keep pupils fully inside natural lids. No widened white bands, oversized or round/vector irises, bright specular flashes, changed brows, altered lids, eye enlargement, blur, smoothing, gradients, or facial redesign.
